description: Dunit musl port (M6) fs: read path — buffered stdio reads over the native Read syscall. userspace/ctests/musl_read.c writes two lines with fputs, reopens the file, and reads them back with fgets x2 + fgetc EOF. __stdio_read/readv have no readv on Dunit and go through native Read. Run: tools/qemu_test.py --build --markers-file tools/m6_musl_read_markers.json --post-boot-delay 3 --settle 4 --cmd-timeout 45 --timeout 160 --boot-timeout 110

required.claim: the system booted to the terminal
fgets read both lines (6 + 11 bytes) through __stdio_read -> native Read and fgetc hit EOF
both lines matched exactly — the buffered stdio read path works
